acceptance.description: App shell fills the viewport without page-level scrolling
acceptance.check: Set the window to 1440x900; assert .app (c1) computed height equals 100vh, overflow is hidden, and body has no scrollbar.

acceptance.description: Content region is a main column beside a right sidebar rail
acceptance.check: Verify c3 (.main) and c8 (.sidebar) are siblings inside c1, both flex children with gap var(--s4), and that the three main cards (c5, c6, c7) plus the two sidebar cards (c9, c10) are direct children of their respective columns.

acceptance.description: Timeline card keeps its fixed 236px height
acceptance.check: Assert computed height of c7 is 236px and flex: none, and that it does not grow when c5 and c6 have little content.

acceptance.description: Titlebar matches the measured bar spec
acceptance.check: Measure c2: height 56px, horizontal padding var(--s4), gap var(--s4), background linear-gradient(180deg,#1a1f27 0%,#151920 100%), bottom border 1px var(--border).

acceptance.description: All cards use the shared panel treatment
acceptance.check: For c5, c6, c7, c9, c10 assert background gradient rgba(255,255,255,.028) to transparent over var(--panel), 1px var(--border), border-radius var(--r3) (8px), and box-shadow inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.035), var(--sh-1).

acceptance.description: Only palette colours from the design tokens are used
acceptance.check: Sample every filled surface and text colour in the rendered page and confirm each is one of #ffffff, #d4a853, #4fd1c5, #000000, #4ecb8f, #e05c5c, #5b9dff or the listed dark neutrals; typography is Inter with body 12px and headings 18px.

acceptance.description: Tabs switch the displayed gesture data
acceptance.check: Click a non-active tab in c4 and assert the active pill moves, the active tab text is #d4a853, and the event/stats/timeline cards re-query for the selected gesture type.

acceptance.description: Capture can be started and stopped from the titlebar
acceptance.check: Click the capture control in c2 and assert isCapturing flips, the live indicator changes between pulsing and static, and event rows stop appending while stopped.

acceptance.description: Event stream reads from the local GestureEvent entity
acceptance.check: Seed five GestureEvent records and assert c5 renders exactly five rows, newest first, each showing type, phase and timestamp, with no network request issued.
Toggle a row in c10 and assert the GestureMapping.enabled flag is written to the local store, the row renders in its disabled visual state (45% text opacity), and the change survives a page reload.
With no Device record, assert c9 shows the empty state; after pairing one, assert name, connectionState and battery render and the titlebar status accent turns #4ecb8f.

acceptance.description: Desktop breakpoint layout holds down to 1024px
acceptance.check: At 1024px viewport width assert the main column and sidebar still render side by side with no horizontal overflow and no clipped card content; below 1024px the sidebar stacks under the main column.

acceptance.description: Tabs and mapping rows are keyboard operable
acceptance.check: Tab into c4 and c10 from the titlebar, assert focus rings (#5b9dff, 2px) are visible, arrow keys move between tabs with the active tab announced, and each mapping toggle exposes role=switch with aria-checked matching its state.

acceptance.description: Status information is not conveyed by colour alone
acceptance.check: Simulate a disconnected device and assert c9 and c2 show an explicit text label alongside the #e05c5c colour, and that the warning region is announced via aria-live.
